entries.question: Provide me token geraration Drifcase qr code
entries.answer:
To generate a token for your visit to KGMU, please note that KGMU does not use "Drifcase" for token generation. You must use the official government portals or walk-in registration.

### Official OPD Registration Methods:
*   **Online Appointment (Recommended):** Visit the [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in) to book an appointment.
*   **Mobile App:** Use the **ABHA/Health Care App** to register with your mobile number and OTP.
*   **SMS Service:** Send `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in:** You can visit the OPD registration counter in person. Bring your **Aadhaar card** and an active mobile number to receive an OTP, which is required to generate your physical token and pay the ₹50 fee.

**Important Notes:**
*   Online registration is mandatory to avoid long wait times.
*   The OPD ticket counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
*   If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please ensure you carry a valid referral letter for the specific department you are visiting.

For further assistance, you may contact the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

appointment kaise hoga

Dr. Vibha Singh is a Professor in the Department of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery at KGMU. To consult with her or any doctor at KGMU, you must register for an OPD appointment.

**How to book an appointment:**

*   **Online (Recommended):** Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) (Online Registration System). Select Uttar Pradesh, then KGMU, and choose the appropriate department to book your slot.
*   **Mobile App:** You can use the ABHA/Health Care app to register and book your appointment.
*   **SMS:** Send an SMS with the text `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in:** You can visit the KGMU OPD in person. Bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to generate an OTP, collect a physical token, and pay the ₹50 registration fee at the counter.

**Important Information:**
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM–12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).
*   **Registration Fee:** ₹50 for all booking methods.
*   **Referral:** If you are traveling from outside Lucknow, please carry a valid medical referral for the specific department.
*   **Note:** The OPD ticket counter closes strictly at 1:00 PM. It is highly recommended to pre-book your appointment to avoid long wait times.

I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at the KGMU OPD or call the KGMU helpline at 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333 for further assistance. Please avoid sharing personal details like Aadhaar numbers or contact information in this chat for your safety.

entries.question: kya direct apointment mil jayga ya junior resident ke pass milega
entries.answer:
KGMU ki OPD mein appointment ki prakriya ek nishchit pranaali (system) ke tahat hoti hai. Iske baare mein mahatvapurn jankari niche di gayi hai:

1. **OPD Pranaali:** Jab aap online ya walk-in ke madhyam se ₹50 ki parchi banwakar OPD mein jate hain, toh aapko sabse pehle department ke screening area mein jana hota hai. Wahan ke Junior Residents (JR) ya Senior Residents (SR) sabse pehle mareez ko dekhte hain, unki medical history lete hain aur zaroori jaanch (investigations) likhte hain.
2. **Senior Doctors/Professors se mulakat:** Agar case complex hai ya Senior Professor (jaise Dr. Vibha Singh) ki vishesh salah ki avashyakta hoti hai, toh residents aapko unke paas refer karte hain.
3. **Direct Appointment:** KGMU mein kisi specific Professor se "direct" appointment lene ki koi alag se booking window nahi hoti hai. OPD mein mareezon ki sankhya adhik hone ke kaaran, pehle residents patient ko dekhte hain aur zaroorat padne par hi Senior Consultants/Professors ka supervision milta hai.

**Salah:**
*   Agar aapko kisi gambhir samasya ke liye Professor se hi milna hai, toh aap subah samay par OPD pahunche aur wahan ke staff ko apni sthiti ke baare mein batayein.
*   Yadi aapke paas pehle ki koi medical reports, x-rays, ya kisi anya hospital ka referral hai, toh use zaroor lekar jayein; isse doctors ko aapki sthiti samajhne mein aasani hogi.

Main ek AI chatbot hoon aur medical advice nahi de sakta. Kripya aap OPD mein jakar wahan ke duty doctor se paramarsh lein. 

**Helpline numbers:** 0522-2258880 ya 0522-3539333 par call karke aap OPD ki navintam sthiti ke baare mein puch sakte hain.

entries.answer:

If your case requires specialized attention or falls under the specific expertise of a senior consultant, the resident doctors will refer your case to the senior faculty member, such as **Dr. Vibha Singh**.

entries.question: Kya bsc radiotherapy technology aur bsc radiology same hi hai
entries.answer:
B.Sc. Radiotherapy Technology aur B.Sc. Radiology (Radiological Imaging Technology) takneeki roop se alag-alag field hain, halanki dono medical imaging aur radiation se sambandhit hain:

1. **B.Sc. Radiotherapy Technology:** Isme cancer ke upchar (treatment) ke liye radiation ka upyog kaise kiya jaye, is par dhyan kendrit kiya jata hai. Ismein aap cancer patients ko radiation dene wali machines (jaise Linear Accelerators) ko chalana seekhte hain.
2. **B.Sc. Radiology / Radiology Imaging Technology:** Ismein bimariyon ka pata lagane (diagnosis) ke liye imaging ka upyog kiya jata hai. Ismein aap X-ray, Ultrasound, CT Scan, aur MRI jaisi machines ka upyog karke body ke andar ki tasveerein lena seekhte hain.

KGMU ke exam notices mein aksar **B.Sc. Radiotherapy Technology** ka ullekh milta hai. Admission lene se pehle, main website [www.kgmu.org](http://www.kgmu.org) par jaakar 'Courses' section mein apne liye sahi course ka chayan avashya karein, kyunki dono ke career path aur padhai ka uddeshya alag hota hai.

entries.question: Medical cirtificate bnane btaye
entries.answer:
KGMU mein medical certificate banwane ke liye niche di gayi prakriya ka palan karein:

1. **OPD Registration:** Sabse pehle aapko KGMU mein OPD registration karwana hoga. Aap online (ORS - [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)) ya hospital mein jakar walk-in registration kar sakte hain. Registration shulk ₹50 hai.
2. **Sambandhit Vibhag (Department):** Jis bimari ya karan se aapko medical certificate chahiye, us vibhag ki OPD mein jayein.
3. **Doctor se Paramarsh:** Wahan doctor ko apni pareshani batayein. Agar doctor ko zaruri lagta hai, toh woh aapki jaanch (tests) likhenge ya aapko observe karenge.
4. **Certificate ke liye Anurodh:** Doctor ke upchar (treatment) ke baad, aap unse medical certificate ke liye anurodh kar sakte hain. Doctor apni clinical assessment ke aadhar par hi certificate jari karte hain.
5. **Office/Verification:** Certificate milne ke baad, kabhi-kabhi us par hospital ki official mohar (stamp) lagwani padti hai, jiske liye aapko PRO office ya hospital ke administrative vibhag se sampark karna pad sakta hai.

**Kuch Zaruri Baatein:**
*   Medical certificate sirf doctor ke mulyankan (assessment) par hi milta hai; yeh koi automatic ya paid service nahi hai.
*   Apne saath apni pehchan patra (Aadhaar card) aur purani medical reports jarur rakhein.
*   Agar aap kisi sarkari kaam ya chutti ke liye certificate chahte hain, toh uske liye nirdharit format lekar jayein.

Main ek AI hoon, isliye main medical certificate nahi bana sakta. Aapko vyaktigat roop se hospital jakar doctor se milna hoga.

entries.question: How to take the appointment
entries.answer:
You can book an appointment at KGMU using any of the following methods. Please note that online registration is mandatory and the OPD slip fee is ₹50.

### Booking Methods

*   **Online Registration System (ORS):**
    1. Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in).
    2. Select "Uttar Pradesh" and then "KGMU" from the list of hospitals.
    3. Choose "New Appointment," select the department (e.g., Orthopedics), date, and time.
    4. Enter patient details, pay the ₹50 fee, and download your appointment slip.

*   **ABHA / Health Care App:**
    Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same hospital selection flow as the ORS portal.

*   **SMS Appointment:**
    Send an SMS with the text `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.

*   **Walk-in Registration:**
    1. Visit the KGMU OPD counter.
    2. Bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to receive the OTP.
    3. Obtain a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip.

### Important Information
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).
*   **Parchi/Ticket Counter:** Closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
*   **Referral:** Patients coming from outside Lucknow should carry a valid referral for the specific department.
*   **Recommendation:** Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

For further assistance, you may call the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

entries.question: Ane ki possibility hai
entries.answer:
KGMU में भर्तियों (जैसे स्टाफ नर्स या प्रोजेक्ट स्टाफ) का आना समय-समय पर विभिन्न प्रोजेक्ट्स, फंड्स और रिक्तियों (vacancies) पर निर्भर करता है। आधिकारिक तौर पर भविष्य की भर्तियों के लिए कोई निश्चित तारीख पहले से घोषित नहीं होती है, लेकिन आप निम्नलिखित तरीकों से अपडेट रह सकते हैं:

1. **ऑफिशियल नोटिस बोर्ड:** KGMU समय-समय पर अपनी वेबसाइट पर भर्तियां निकालता है। आप नियमित रूप से [kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php](https://www.kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) चेक करते रहें।
2. **विभागों की वेबसाइट:** कई प्रोजेक्ट्स सीधे संबंधित विभागों (जैसे पीडियाट्रिक्स, मेडिसिन, या कम्युनिटी मेडिसिन) के तहत आते हैं। आप [kgmu.org/department.php](https://www.kgmu.org/department.php) पर जाकर अपने रुचि के विभाग के पेज को देख सकते हैं, वहां अक्सर प्रोजेक्ट-आधारित भर्तियों की जानकारी दी जाती है।
3. **अखबार:** KGMU की भर्तियों के विज्ञापन प्रमुख समाचार पत्रों में भी प्रकाशित किए जाते हैं।

चूंकि KGMU एक बड़ा संस्थान है, इसलिए नई भर्तियों की संभावना हमेशा बनी रहती है। आप अपनी तैयारी जारी रखें और वेबसाइट पर नज़र बनाए रखें। 

**नोट:** किसी भी अनधिकृत वेबसाइट या व्यक्ति के बहकावे में न आएं जो नौकरी दिलाने का दावा करे। हमेशा KGMU की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट पर दी गई जानकारी पर ही भरोसा करें।
